meta.description: C. Anthouli Ltd is a Larnaca based firm providing tax advisory, audit and assurance, tax compliance, accounting and business advisory services to national and international clients.

about.title: A trusted partner for businesses that want more than a compliant set of accounts
about.p1: C. Anthouli Ltd is a trusted provider of professional services specialising in tax advisory, audit and compliance solutions. From our offices in Larnaca we serve national and international corporations, family businesses and individuals with dedication to excellence and integrity.
about.p2: Our mission is to deliver bespoke, high quality services that go beyond numbers, providing strategic insights and ensuring regulatory compliance while building lasting partnerships with our clients.

values.title: Integrity
values.text: Independent, objective and transparent in everything we sign our name to.

values.title: Precision
values.text: Rigorous technical work, reviewed by senior professionals before it reaches you.

values.title: Partnership
values.text: We take time to understand your business, so our advice fits your goals and not a template.

values.title: Responsiveness
values.text: Direct access to the people doing the work, with clear answers when you need them.

about.teamTitle: Led by experienced professionals, supported by a dedicated team
about.teamText: Our firm is led by two directors who remain personally involved in every engagement. Behind them stands a team of qualified accountants, auditors and tax specialists who combine international training with deep knowledge of the Cyprus regulatory environment. We keep our team deliberately close knit, so every client knows exactly who is looking after them.

team.bio: Leading the firm with extensive expertise in tax advisory and corporate compliance, specialising in international tax structures and regulatory excellence.

team.name: Gabriel Anthoulis
team.bio: Directing comprehensive audit and assurance services with a focus on financial reporting, risk management and stakeholder confidence.

whyCyprus.title: An EU jurisdiction built for international business
whyCyprus.intro: Cyprus combines a competitive and transparent tax system, a common law legal framework, full EU membership and a strategic location at the crossroads of three continents. Following the 2026 tax reform the system remains one of the most attractive in the European Union.

figures.label: Corporate income tax, among the lowest in the EU
Withholding tax on outbound dividends, interest and royalties
IP Box exemption, an effective rate of around 3%
Non dom status with no tax on dividends and interest

categories.title: Tax
points: Corporate income tax of 15% from 2026, still among the lowest in the European Union
No withholding tax on dividends, interest and royalties paid abroad, with limited exceptions
Profits from the sale of shares and other securities are exempt from tax
Dividend participation exemption for holding companies
IP Box regime with an 80% deduction on qualifying intellectual property income
Notional interest deduction on new equity, reducing the effective rate to as low as 3%
Tax losses carried forward for seven years and stamp duty abolished from 2026
Network of more than 65 double tax treaties, including with the UK, Russia, India and China

categories.title: Legal and Corporate
points: Legal system based on English common law, familiar to international investors
Companies Law Cap. 113 modelled on UK company law, with documents accepted in English
Full EU member state since 2004 with access to the single market and EU directives
Euro currency since 2008, with no exchange controls
Fast track headquartering scheme through the Business Facilitation Unit for foreign interest companies
Work permits for third country staff issued within roughly one month

categories.title: Accounting and Audit
points: IFRS as adopted by the EU is the mandatory reporting framework for all companies
Statutory audit by licensed auditors regulated by ICPAC gives financial statements international credibility
Over 5,000 registered accountants and 800 accounting firms serving international clients
Financial statements prepared in English are accepted by banks and regulators worldwide
Strong professional standards under ACCA, ICAEW and ICPAC qualifications

categories.title: Individuals and Relocation
points: Non domiciled residents pay no Special Defence Contribution on dividends and interest for 17 years
Tax residency in as little as 60 days a year under the 60 day rule
50% income tax exemption for 17 years for new residents earning above EUR 55,000
Personal income tax free threshold of EUR 22,000 from 2026
No inheritance tax and no wealth tax
Digital nomad visa for non EU remote workers

categories.title: Shipping and Logistics
points: EU approved tonnage tax system for ship owners, charterers and managers, extended to 2029
Limassol is the largest third party ship management centre in the EU
Two international airports at Larnaca and Paphos and deep water ports at Limassol and Larnaca
Time zone that allows same day business with Asia, Europe and the Americas
Modern telecommunications and a growing technology and fintech cluster

categories.title: Location and People
points: Strategic position at the crossroads of Europe, the Middle East, Asia and Africa
English widely spoken in business, banking and public administration
60% of adults aged 25 to 34 hold a university degree, one of the highest shares in the EU
Set up and operating costs noticeably lower than in mature EU financial centres
Safe, stable environment with an exceptional quality of life and 300 days of sunshine

whyCyprus.disclaimer: Figures reflect Cyprus legislation in force for tax year 2026, including the tax reform enacted in December 2025. Rules change and conditions apply; please contact us for advice on your specific circumstances.
